passages.original: breuiter ergo dicam, quantum cum absente loqui possum, quid sentire cum catholica ecclesia debeas, id est, ut cum gratia domini operationem baptizati famuli semper adiungas et eum, qui praedestinationem excluso labore hominis adserit, cum Pelagii dogmate detesteris.
passages.english: I will therefore say briefly, as far as I can speak with one who is absent, what you ought to hold together with the catholic Church: that is, that you should always join the working of the baptized servant to the grace of the Lord, and that you should detest, together with the doctrine of Pelagius, anyone who asserts predestination to the exclusion of human effort.
passages.notes: "operationem baptizati famuli": literally "the working of the baptized servant", i.e. the human effort of the baptized Christian, joined to divine grace.
